sketches.mechanism: An uninhabited data type with an empty case expression lets a function produce any return type because the argument can never exist.
sketches.resonance: Only what can never arrive can satisfy every demand.

sketches.mechanism: A deleted copy constructor makes any attempt to initialize a second object from the first a compile-time error.
sketches.resonance: The type system permits one heart to exist, then refuses its duplication.

sketches.mechanism: A for loop over a null range is well-formed but executes zero iterations when the lower bound exceeds the upper bound.
sketches.resonance: The path is syntactically present, yet no step can ever take place.
